title: Communication Arts and Sciences, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs, cross-checked against a raw curl fetch (not just WebFetch's summary) because the printed per-semester subtotals needed to be re-added by hand to confirm the page's own 'Total Credits 123' line. Real, verified differences from the 2025/2026 plan for this same major: (1) LA 83 and LA 283 (the two 1.5cr 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar'-family items in the 2025/2026 plan) do not exist in this catalog year at all -- Semester 1 and Semester 2 are plain 16cr/16cr with no seminar line item, not 17.5cr/16cr. (2) The 2022-23 Suggested Academic Plan's own Fourth Year Spring semester lists five 3cr items (two CAS 4XX-level courses plus three Electives = 15cr), one Elective credit more than every later year (2023-24 onward lists only four items there = 12cr) -- this is a real, bulletin-printed difference, not a copy error; verified by hand-summing all eight semester subtotals (16+16+16+15+15+15+15+15=123) against the page's own stated 'Total Credits 123' before trusting it. (3) The Fourth Year Fall 'World Cultures' Gen Ed slot is labeled 'Other Cultures' in this catalog year's own printed table (PSU's Gen Ed nomenclature changed to 'World Cultures' by the 2024-25 edition; see CASBA-2024.json) -- same requirement, renamed later, kept as a plain unenforced slot either way per this project's existing convention. Everything else -- the CAS 301/303/304/311 core, the CAS Additional Course pool (CAS 203/210/215/220, confirmed identical in this year's own Program Requirements tab), the CAS 4XX-level and Supporting CAS course match patterns, the CAS 100A/100B/100C cross-listed intro option, the ENGL 202A-D pool, entrance-to-the-major language (2.00 GPA), and the Communication Studies (Berks/Brandywine, 15cr, CAS 204) vs. Foundations Scholarship and Practice (University Park, 18cr, this plan's own modeled option) split -- is byte-identical to the current 2026 plan's own already-verified modeling, so those parts were carried over unchanged rather than re-derived. This file mirrors the 2026 plan's campus tag (University Park + Brandywine, Pattern A per docs/BRANCH_CAMPUS_FINDINGS.md) since the underlying University College Brandywine page was confirmed to publish this same shared curriculum in this era too (2018-19+ per the bulletin's own archive-availability note); not independently re-verified against a 2022-era Brandywine-specific page beyond that this major's core+option structure was already unchanged since 2022 in the Liberal Arts page checked directly. Elective-pool and Gen Ed domain slots remain unenforced placeholders, same convention as the current plan.
